policy.title: Link policy
policy.description: Rules for discovering files and mapping them into the home directory.

default_mapping.title: Default mapping
default_mapping.description: Maps each discovered path to the same relative path under HOME.

link_kind.title: Default link kind
link_kind.description: Link kind used by the default discovery policy.

ignore.title: Ignored paths
ignore.description: Glob patterns excluded from default file discovery.

links.title: Explicit links
links.description: Additional links declared as TOML array-of-tables entries.

source.title: Source path
source.description: Non-empty relative path under the dotfiles root. Parent path components are not allowed.

target.title: Target path
target.description: Non-empty path under HOME or an absolute path. Parent path components are not allowed.

kind.title: Link kind
kind.description: File link by default; directory links must be declared explicitly.
